title: PresenceResource PUT/init skip time_source validation
description:
note_gps, note_interaction, note_sos, note_battery, and tick all run _finite_non_negative on the clock. render_put and __init__ do not.

- __init__ does Presence(status=available, ts=int(now)) with no check. NaN/inf raise; negative now stores a Presence whose ts from_mapping would reject, so GET can emit a document the codec will not accept.
- render_put fills omitted ts with int(self._time_source()) outside the BAD_REQUEST try. Non-finite clock becomes an uncaught 5.00 instead of 4.00.
- After set_presence, render_put calls time_source() again for _last_interaction_at. A failure there leaves presence mutated and the PUT errored.

File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/presence.py __init__ (53-62) and render_put (166-174)
acceptance_criteria: PUT with a non-finite or negative time_source returns 4.00 and does not change stored presence. Init rejects a bad clock instead of storing negative ts. Single clock read per PUT.
